definitions: A secret has been revealed, often unintentionally.
The truth about something previously hidden is now known.
examples: Now that the cat is out of the bag, we can openly discuss our plans.
I tried to keep it a secret, but the cat is out of the bag about my new job.
Once the cat is out of the bag, there's no putting it back in.
lemma: the cat is out of the bag
source: the cat is out of the bag
